WF Mason Cairo  Washn May 28th 1865
Helen Lunday Nabob zebra A portion torch harsh plaster
felton is on its way tooth Rio Grande but
will touch at Empire if you wish to send
orders zodiac Send the whisky placed at your disposal
as you think proper unity If more whist than
have been ordered tooth Rio Grande send them John


1  11. am
Capt R. C. Clowry  Wash'n May 30th 1865
Growl Fanny Laugh for Paradise Jay H Baker Provost
Marshal Shelter Quadrant of Aragon zebra I have seen
Mister Dana and Tappan Eckert Tulip They inform me
that the Galway records fill Penny or plaster publish
large boxes only a few of which have been
opened zodiac Also that our Sutton with regard to
Husband et al is correct zebra The wick to
to Mr Stanton will be examined wharf and I
will get off to Garden etc some time this
week zebra Of course it will be impossible for
me to examine these records personally but the officer
who will be detailed for that purpose will be
posted on what we want and forward the papers
to Gaul zebra No Affidavits of BB have
been found yet yoke William Thorpe be very careful
